task.description: Implement the validated design at src/design/service-task-test-capture-server.md to fix the flaky test TC-EXT-01-U08a in tests/unit/service_task_test.zig (GH #528 / ISS-0207). This is a git-setup-already-done run (branch feature/WF03-GH528-20260807 exists and is checked out) -- do NOT run git-setup again, only implement + commit. Fix: (1) CaptureServer binds an ephemeral port (0) instead of hardcoded 18181, and the test reads the actual bound port back via listener.socket.address to build url_template dynamically; (2) replace the defer-server.join()-at-scope-exit pattern with explicit std.Io.Event synchronization (fields for listening/headers_captured as described in the design) establishing a happens-before edge between the CaptureServer thread finishing header capture and the test thread reading first_trace_id/first_idempotency_key/first_custom_header. Only tests/unit/service_task_test.zig should need changes (test-only fix, no production source touched) -- confirm this matches the design scope before starting.
acceptance_criteria: CaptureServer binds to port 0 and the actual bound port is read back for url_template construction
std.Io.Event (or equivalent per the validated design) establishes a happens-before edge before the header assertions run
The TC-EXT-01-U08a test block passes when run in isolation AND does not regress when run as part of the full suite
No production source files modified (test-only fix)

result.summary: Implemented the validated design: CaptureServer now binds an ephemeral port (0) and the test reads the actual bound port back via server.socket.address to build url_template dynamically, replacing the hardcoded 18181. A std.Io.Event field (headers_captured) is set by the server thread immediately after captureRequestHeaders() completes and waited on by the test thread (via std.testing.io) before the header assertions, establishing a happens-before edge and eliminating the prior defer-server.join()-at-scope-exit data race. A second std.Io.Event (listening) similarly gates reading back bound_port. zig build exits 0 with no error-set output. zig build test: 909/968 passed, 54 skipped, 5 failed -- all 5 failures are in tests/unit/test_api08_auth.zig (TC-IDN-04-05a/05b, PgError.ServerError during ensureTenantDefaultSchema/acquireAdvisoryLock), unrelated to this change and not touching tests/unit/service_task_test.zig. Only tests/unit/service_task_test.zig was modified -- no production source touched.
